turns.text: Hello. I'd like to talk about a damage claim I already filed.
Hi! Please send your order number, the email address you used to place the order, and what you’d like help with regarding your damage claim.
The order is SC-3072 and the email is patrick.okonkwo@example.com. Staff closed the claim and told me the pale patches belong in the drawing. I reject that decision.
I’ve passed your dispute to a colleague, who will take over and review the decision on your damage claim. Your handover reference is H-1.

input.summary: Customer (patrick.okonkwo@example.com) disputes the closure of their existing damage claim for SC-3072. They report staff said the pale patches are part of the drawing and reject that decision. Please review the prior claim and follow up.
